description: Turing's child-machine concept and computational learning hypotheses influenced Rosenblatt's design of physical learning networks.
Backpropagation generalized the single-layer perceptron delta rule to multi-layer non-linear hidden representations.
LeNet-5 utilized backpropagation with stochastic gradient descent across 2D spatial convolution kernels.
LSTM was specifically engineered to solve the vanishing gradient failure of backpropagation through time.
AlexNet was hand-optimized in custom CUDA C code to run 2D convolutions in parallel across two GTX 580 GPUs.
AlexNet scaled the fundamental convolutional hierarchy pioneered in LeNet to 8 deep layers and ImageNet scale.
The deep learning revival ignited by AlexNet inspired continuous distributed representation research in NLP.
Deep discriminative networks provided the core adversary architecture for training generative generator networks.
ResNet solved the optimization degradation barrier that limited earlier CNNs to under 20 layers, pushing depth to 152+ layers.
Deep convolutional residual architectures powered AlphaGo's policy and value networks for Go board evaluation.
AlphaGo used clusters of Google TPU v1 chips in real-time during the match against Lee Sedol.
The Transformer was designed to surpass LSTM recurrent bottlenecks by computing direct pairwise self-attention in O(1) sequential steps.
BERT utilizes a deep bidirectional stack of Transformer encoder blocks.
GPT-2 scales the autoregressive causal Transformer decoder architecture.
GPT-3 scaled the causal transformer from 1.5B parameters to 175B parameters, unlocking in-context few-shot learning.
AlphaFold 2 adapted self-attention into the Evoformer architecture to exchange information across biological sequences and residue pairs.
CLIP utilizes Vision Transformers (ViT) and text Transformer encoders for multimodal joint embedding.
Stable Diffusion uses pretrained frozen CLIP text encoders to guide latent space diffusion via cross-attention.
InstructGPT fine-tuned GPT-3 base checkpoints with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback.
Massive clusters of NVIDIA Hopper and Ampere GPUs provided the compute infrastructure for training and serving GPT-4.
GPT-4 incorporated advanced RLHF and rule-based reward models developed during InstructGPT experiments.
LLaMA is an autoregressive decoder Transformer incorporating SwiGLU, RMSNorm, and Rotary Positional Embeddings.
Llama 3.1 405B represents the frontier culmination of the Llama open architecture series.
Contemporary frontier multimodal models competing across coding, vision, and tool-use intelligence.
OpenAI o1 builds on pre-trained foundation models with large-scale RL for test-time reasoning compute.
DeepSeek-V3 expands the transformer with Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) and 256-expert Mixture-of-Experts routing.
DeepSeek-R1 was trained directly on the DeepSeek-V3 base architecture using pure reinforcement learning (GRPO).
Frontier reasoning paradigms utilizing reinforcement-learning-driven test-time compute scaling.
